title: Miracle of Healing
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child describes Luke 8:43-48: a woman bleeding for twelve years touches the edge of Jesus' cloak and is healed, Jesus asks who touched him, she falls at his feet, he says "Daughter, your faith has healed you; go in peace"; and names how the church and government help the sick.

floor.question: What did the officer say to Jesus?

representations: a crowd and a hand reaching for a cloak
two columns: church and government help
steps: Twelve years ill; no one could heal her.

board.do: Draw a crowd and a hand touching the edge of a cloak.

board.say: What happened when she touched the cloak?

board.do: Wait for the child to say she was healed.
Write Luke 8:48 and list who helps the sick today.

misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 8:43: no one could heal her. Then 8:44: she touched his cloak and was healed.

misconceptions.ask: For how long had she been bleeding (Luke 8:43)?
misconceptions.repair: Link the number with Jairus' daughter, who was twelve years old (Luke 8:42): both twelves are in one passage.
List hospitals: government (county hospitals) and church (mission hospitals). Both help the sick.

misconceptions.ask: What did the woman do when Jesus asked who touched him (Luke 8:47)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 8:47: she could not go unnoticed; she told everything, and Jesus blessed her.

checks.question: How long had the woman been bleeding?
Name one way the government helps the sick.
